CustomField.description: What happens when this rule fails on a value, for example because its pattern cannot compile. Log and Continue saves the value unmasked, writes a warning, and skips the rule for the rest of the transaction, so later values it covers are saved unmasked too. Write Failure Marker saves [MASKING_FAILURE] in place of the value the rule failed on and keeps running the rule on other values; if the pattern cannot compile, every value the rule covers gets the marker. Block DML refuses the save, and the rule keeps refusing every later save it meets in the transaction.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Log and Continue: the value is saved unmasked, and the rule stops for the rest of the transaction, so later values are saved unmasked too. Write Failure Marker (the default): [MASKING_FAILURE] is saved in place of each value the rule fails on, and the rule keeps masking the others. Block DML: the save is refused, and so is every later save the rule meets in the transaction. Choose the strictest option your data needs.
CustomField.label: Failure Action
